attributes.description: Nginx golden signals: request errors and throughput from access logs, error-log severity, and saturation (request rate, connection states, dropped connections) from stub_status metrics.

embeddableConfig.content:
## Nginx request health

Latency, errors and throughput from the `nginx.access.otel` and `nginx.error.otel` logs, plus dropped connections from `nginxreceiver.otel` stub_status metrics. Shows the instance selected on the Overview, or all instances.

- **Overview** — requests, 4xx/5xx counts and rates, error-log events, dropped connections and reporting instances
- **Latency** — P50/P95/P99 request duration, upstream vs nginx time and the slowest URL paths
- **Requests & errors** — status-class mix and error rates over time, top status codes and the URL paths returning 4xx/5xx
- **Error logs** — error-log events by level over time and by host, the latest error-and-above events and the top message patterns

attributes.description: Request counts and 4xx/5xx response counts broken down by URL path.

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend

| WHERE `4xx responses` + `5xx responses` > 0
| SORT `5xx responses` DESC, `4xx responses` DESC

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS total = COUNT(*), e5 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500, e4 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 400 AND http.response.status_code < 500 BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS t = SUM(total), s5 = SUM(e5), s4 = SUM(e4), p5 = MAX(CASE(total >= 10, e5 * 100.0 / total, NULL)) BY Time = BUCKET(minute, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `5xx error rate` = s5 * 100.0 / t, `4xx error rate` = s4 * 100.0 / t, `5xx peak (1-min)` = p5
| KEEP Time, `5xx error rate`, `5xx peak (1-min)`, `4xx error rate`

FROM logs-nginx.access.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS total = COUNT(*), e5 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500, e4 = COUNT(*) WHERE http.response.status_code >= 400 AND http.response.status_code < 500 BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS t = SUM(total), s5 = SUM(e5), s4 = SUM(e4), p5 = MAX(CASE(total >= 10, e5 * 100.0 / total, NULL)) BY Time = BUCKET(minute, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `5xx error rate` = s5 * 100.0 / t, `4xx error rate` = s4 * 100.0 / t, `5xx peak (1-min)` = p5
| KEEP Time, `5xx error rate`, `5xx peak (1-min)`, `4xx error rate`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx or 5xx status in each time bucket, plus the highest one-minute 5xx share within the bucket (minutes with at least 10 requests) so short error bursts stay visible. A rising 5xx line means clients are getting server errors; a 4xx jump often means broken links, auth problems or scanners.
embeddableConfig.title: 4xx and 5xx error rate over time

query.esql:
FROM logs-nginx.error.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT message LIKE "*open() \"*\" failed (2: No such file or directory)*"
| GROK message "\\[%{WORD}\\] %{NUMBER}#%{NUMBER}: (\\*%{NUMBER} )?%{GREEDYDATA:Message}"
| EVAL sev = CASE(log.level == "emerg", 8, log.level == "alert", 7, log.level == "crit", 6, log.level == "error", 5, log.level == "warn", 4, log.level == "notice", 3, log.level == "info", 2, 1)
| STATS Events = COUNT(*), Hosts = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name), `Last seen` = MAX(@timestamp), sev = MAX(sev), `Example message` = TOP(Message, 1, "desc") BY pattern = CATEGORIZE(Message)
| EVAL Level = CASE(sev == 8, "emerg", sev == 7, "alert", sev == 6, "crit", sev == 5, "error", sev == 4, "warn", sev == 3, "notice", sev == 2, "info", "debug")
| SORT sev DESC, Events DESC
| KEEP Level, `Example message`, Events, Hosts, `Last seen`
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-nginx.error.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT message LIKE "*open() \"*\" failed (2: No such file or directory)*"
| GROK message "\\[%{WORD}\\] %{NUMBER}#%{NUMBER}: (\\*%{NUMBER} )?%{GREEDYDATA:Message}"
| EVAL sev = CASE(log.level == "emerg", 8, log.level == "alert", 7, log.level == "crit", 6, log.level == "error", 5, log.level == "warn", 4, log.level == "notice", 3, log.level == "info", 2, 1)
| STATS Events = COUNT(*), Hosts = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name), `Last seen` = MAX(@timestamp), sev = MAX(sev), `Example message` = TOP(Message, 1, "desc") BY pattern = CATEGORIZE(Message)
| EVAL Level = CASE(sev == 8, "emerg", sev == 7, "alert", sev == 6, "crit", sev == 5, "error", sev == 4, "warn", sev == 3, "notice", sev == 2, "info", "debug")
| SORT sev DESC, Events DESC
| KEEP Level, `Example message`, Events, Hosts, `Last seen`
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: Error-log messages grouped into patterns, most severe level first, then by event count, with one example message, the hosts affected and when the pattern was last seen. Excludes the "open() ... failed (2: No such file or directory)" entries nginx writes for every 404.
embeddableConfig.title: Top 10 error-log message patterns

| EVAL nginx_time = GREATEST(http.server.request.duration - nginx.upstream.response.duration, 0)
| STATS `Upstream response (P95)` = PERCENTILE(nginx.upstream.response.duration, 95), `Nginx and client (P95)` = PERCENTILE(nginx_time, 95) BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: For proxied requests: P95 upstream response time ($upstream_response_time) and P95 of the rest of the request duration (request minus upstream: nginx processing and sending to the client). Whichever line dominates is where the time goes. Attempts where nginx could not connect to the backend (connect time "-") are excluded. For retried requests only the final attempt counts as upstream time, so time spent on earlier failed attempts shows up as nginx and client time.
embeddableConfig.title: Upstream response time vs nginx time

Growing connect time points to network or backend saturation; growing wait time to slow backend processing. Only requests where nginx connected to the backend count; for retried requests only the final attempt is shown.
